name: osint
description: Bounded public-source investigation: probable reporting origins, corroboration with separately rated source reliability and information credibility, source reliability and identity with cited registry and certificate history, organization-keyed infrastructure pivots, cited timelines, relationship paths, and media provenance including video frames.

query_examples.semantics: counts probable origins as well as publications, with credibility; reports an Admiralty information-credibility grade (1-6) beside the carrying source's reliability grade (A-F) as independent axes with derivations; never collapsed into one confidence score

query_examples.intent: Where did these reports come from
query_examples.semantics: current probable origins with explainable document relations; probable, not proof of attribution
a reliability card scored the same way outlets are scored, with an Admiralty source-reliability grade (A-F, F below the minimum track record) and its derivation

query_examples.intent: Timeline of events for an entity
query_examples.semantics: a cited event timeline; each event carries its corroboration density

query_examples.intent: Who owns this organization according to the registries
query_examples.semantics: a cited ownership section from Corporate Ownership records (identity, parents, subsidiaries, officers) resolved only through accepted identity decisions; conflicts side by side; not a beneficial-ownership, sanctions or compliance determination

query_examples.intent: What did each sanctions list state about this organization
query_examples.semantics: per-list designation statements (EU, UN, OFAC, UK) as of a date, cited to snapshots, listing revisions and legal-basis works, resolved only through accepted identity decisions; lists stay separate; not a screening verdict or compliance determination

query_examples.intent: Which other sources share this domain's registrant or certificates
query_examples.semantics: organization-keyed pivot over cited RDAP and certificate-transparency relations; shared infrastructure is probable, never a same-operator verdict; e-mail, username, IP and person identifiers are refused

query_examples.intent: Where did this registry fact come from
query_examples.semantics: source-pack source, acquisition receipt, archive-time observation and the source-identity revisions citing it

query_examples.intent: Is this image or video frame recycled
query_examples.semantics: perceptual-hash near-duplicates across documents, video frames cited by document and offset; flags recycling, not fakery

exclusions: exposed-service search, subdomain enumeration or attack-surface mapping
person-keyed identifier pivoting (e-mail, username, handle, IP address)
real-time tracking, continuous ADS-B or AIS mirroring, area-wide movement queries or movement alerts
user-level profiling from platform transparency data
inference of coordinated behaviour from ads or moderation statements
conversion of ad spend or impression ranges into point estimates
